artifacts.source_reference_convention: The paths in evidence below resolve under artifacts.source_base; all TeX files were obtained from the fixed v1 official arXiv source archive. No TeX or source code was executed.

claims.statement: Collect simulator data, fit model on short replay windows, improve actor and critic on imagined rollouts; both model and policy update throughout training. Prior-policy transitions remain valid dynamics data.
claims.boundary: No separate-policy pretraining requirement. Initial replay fill/warmup details are unknown.

claims.statement: Deterministic policy a=pi(o,g); simulator executes a+epsilon and replay stores the executed noisy action. Action noise only broadens WM action coverage and is optional.
claims.boundary: Clipping/bounding of executed noisy actions is not stated.

claims.statement: Deterministic WM conditions on recorded per-episode physical context xi and predicts noise-free observations; known observation noise is sampled externally and re-added before actor.
claims.boundary: WM state layout/dimension/delta parameterization/rotation representation/FK are not uniquely specified.

claims.statement: Reward, observation and termination heads can each be learned or analytic. An analytic head has no corresponding loss term.
claims.boundary: Published reward formulas do not establish that the actual G1 reward head was analytic. Learned reward alone is not an established deviation.

claims.statement: Autoregressive k=8 logged-action replay window seeded once at the logged initial state; fit per-step state MSE, reward MSE, clean observation MSE and done BCE, omitting analytic-head loss terms.
claims.boundary: Not one-step-only fit or intermediate full teacher forcing. No explicit Jacobian matching, ensemble uncertainty or KL term in Eq.(1). Reset-crossing masking, target scaling and per-feature weights unknown.

claims.statement: H=32 on-policy imagination starts from replay state with recorded xi, adds sensor noise to clean predicted observation each step, and maximizes discounted reward plus terminal critic bootstrap with soft survival weights.
claims.boundary: Immediate r[t+1] is weighted by c[t], not c[t+1]. Actor Eq.(2) is not critic lambda-target fitting or advantage-weighted log-prob.

claims.statement: Freeze omega only inside actor backward while preserving WM Jacobians with respect to state and action over H steps. Mathematically the terminal value retains its dependence on terminal imagined state for dJ/dtheta.
claims.boundary: Freezing model parameters is not equivalent to detaching predicted states or executing entire WM forward under no_grad. Exact framework flags are not published.

claims.statement: Critic uses imagined-only lambda returns, terminal bootstrap, soft done gating, fixed once-per-rollout targets and no EMA target network.
claims.boundary: Exact target/feature detach flags and time-limit truncation bootstrap convention unknown.

claims.statement: Policy takes last 10 proprioceptive observation frames and a goal encoder. K=10 future reference frames feed motion encoder. The 32D tanh-bounded z is the policy goal/motor latent, not a stochastic world-model latent.
claims.boundary: 93 per-frame observation dimensions is arithmetic from the table, not a disclosed WM state dimension. No RSSM posterior/prior/KL is specified.

claims.statement: Motion reward follows BeyondMimic with self-collision removed and joint-limit coefficient lowered from -10 to -2. All reward terms are multiplied by control dt=.02. Action maps q_sp=alpha*a+q0 with low PD gains.
claims.boundary: Per-joint alpha, gains, action clip/squash/bounds and training reward normalization are unknown; tanh is explicitly stated only for z.

claims.statement: Return-based simulator reset sampling over 1s bins: 50% uniform, 40% softmax(-25*G_b/Gmax), 10% proportional to historical softmax weight.
claims.boundary: This is episode reset curriculum, not evidence of prioritized WM replay windows. Running-estimate smoothing details unknown.

claims.statement: Motion tracking terminates on root height-reference deviation >.25m or gravity-z tilt error >.8 (~78deg upright), not end-effector deviation. Training omits root-velocity pushes because they inject discontinuities the deterministic WM cannot capture.
claims.boundary: Noise/physical DR alone is not a deviation; unconditioned hidden dynamic randomness and jump events test a different modeling premise.

claims.statement: Large benchmark evaluates each of 129514 training motions once from first frame; friction1/noDR/noobsnoise/deterministic; each policy keeps its own gains/action scale/obs construction. Failure counts measure training coverage, not unseen-motion generalization.
claims.boundary: These are evaluation settings, not evidence that training lacked DR/noise.

claims.statement: The paper explicitly calls its analytic policy gradient a gradient of a surrogate for expected return in simulation. Eq.(1) supervises prediction values, not Jacobians. Figure2c errors .007-.011 are normalized 8-step state-only errors on online policy rollouts.
claims.boundary: Not an unbiased true-simulator gradient guarantee, reward/done accuracy result, held-out bound, H32 error bound or Jacobian validation. Nominal-error normalization values unknown.

claims.statement: Default H32 was fastest; larger H was not monotonically better. Critic helps short horizons and perturbation recovery even where no-critic nominal return is similar.
claims.boundary: Source plot values, not cross-seed statistics. null means target not reached for this row. Training-episode return has evolving reset distribution and differs from fixed checkpoint evaluation.

claims.statement: Dense per-step tracking reward and flat-ground humanoid dynamics are the demonstrated setting. No terrain or object interactions; simulator-only dynamics. Several-seed stability is textually reported but seed variation is not plotted.
claims.boundary: Sparse rewards, terrain, object contact and arbitrary hidden stochastic dynamics require separate evidence.

claims.statement: Interfaces share a WM and decoder, with separate encoders/rewards/dones/critics. Downstream objective freezes shared decoder weights but retains decoder input Jacobian; main motion objective still trains decoder. Velocity RL has weight .1 MSE alignment toward stopgrad motion latent on reference-command rollouts.
claims.boundary: Algorithm A.1 samples one interface/update, while actual joint velocity experiment explicitly mixes interfaces per batch. Preliminary one-seed downstream result, not general multi-interface guarantee.

training_hyperparameters.ratio_caveat: WM update comprises 10 batches. Policy/model outer-update ratio 1 is not one policy update per WM optimizer minibatch. Exact UTD denominator and simulator steps per outer iteration are not further specified.
